about: R1 search and R2 iterator-workspace mutants, owned by nfa. WorkspaceReusesStorage catches per-line storage setup invisible to Boolean agreement; WorkspaceAgreesWithReferences catches stale frontier/marks, frontier overwrite, lost epsilon branches and wrong acceptance mode. Matcher.LinesAgree and LinesStop cover iterator ordering and consumer stop. RC1 capture mutants: CapturesAgree compares the tagged machine with the reference for Parse and Find event for event; TagWorkIsBounded counts thread steps; DateCaptures guards the Occurrences/Last projections; ParsesCountsAndGroups and CaptureFailuresAreNamed guard grammar and Check rows no law reads.

mutants.name: RC1-priority-reversed
mutants.from:
v.add(p, s.X, h, at)
		v.add(p, s.Y, h, at)
mutants.to:
v.add(p, s.Y, h, at)
		v.add(p, s.X, h, at)
mutants.rule: Threads keep branch priority: X (left, one more copy) before Y. Boolean matching cannot see the order; CapturesAgree compares the chosen history with the reference.

mutants.name: RC1-history-last-only
mutants.from: v.add(p, s.Next, syntax.Then{Before: h, Event: e}, at)
mutants.to: v.add(p, s.Next, if s.Open { syntax.Then{Before: syntax.Start, Event: e} } else { syntax.Then{Before: h, Event: e} }, at)
mutants.rule: Every occurrence stays in the history (q124); an engine that keeps only what follows the last Open loses earlier occurrences. CapturesAgree.

mutants.name: RC1-find-first-accept
mutants.from: Threads: r.Threads[:i], At: r.At, Best: Some{Value: best}
mutants.to: Threads: []Thread{}, At: r.At, Best: Some{Value: best}
mutants.rule: Find keeps the threads of higher priority than the first accepting one: a greedy repeat must go on. CapturesAgree.

mutants.name: RC1-find-keeps-lower
mutants.from: Threads: r.Threads[:i], At: r.At, Best: Some{Value: best}
mutants.to: Threads: r.Threads[i+1:], At: r.At, Best: Some{Value: best}
mutants.rule: Threads after the first accepting one have lower priority and are dropped, else their later match replaces a better one. CapturesAgree.

mutants.name: RC1-closure-dedup
mutants.rule: A second thread at one instruction has the same future and lower priority, so the answer is unchanged and only the work grows; TagWorkIsBounded counts the steps.

mutants.name: RC1-reference-optional-required
mutants.from: either(trace(q.Of, text, i, h, k), func() Option[ended] { k(i, h) })
mutants.rule: An enclosing optional is optional in the reference too; CapturesAgree compares both sides, so a broken reference fails it.

mutants.name: RC1-occurrences-last-only
mutants.rule: Occurrences is every occurrence; Last is the separate projection (q124). DateCaptures; CapturesAgree compares events only.

mutants.name: RC1-absent-empty-projection
mutants.rule: A group that took no part is None, not an empty occurrence. DateCaptures.

mutants.name: RC1-copies-refused
mutants.rule: Copies of one group that a counted repeat wrote out are one capture; CaptureSample makes such copies and CapturesAgree needs Check to accept them.

mutants.name: RC1-check-admits-nullable
mutants.rule: Check refuses a repeat whose operand matches the empty text, as RC3 does. CaptureFailuresAreNamed (diagnostic row).

mutants.name: RC1-digit-literal
mutants.rule: \d is the ASCII digits (q125). Print never writes \d, so RoundTrip cannot see it; ParsesCountsAndGroups.

mutants.name: RC1-count-extra-copy
mutants.rule: Counted writes exactly min mandatory copies. Print writes the copies out, so RoundTrip cannot see a wrong count; ParsesCountsAndGroups.

mutants.name: R2-whole-iterator-value
mutants.rule: Matcher.LinesAgree checks emitted Whole line values, not only counts. The existing Whole CLI case uses count mode, the workspace property checks Whole booleans and Inside line values, and Matches laws cannot observe iterator payloads.

mutants.name: R2-shared-iterator
mutants.rule: Scratch belongs inside the iterator invocation. The existing S108 mutable-capture rule rejects this mutant before execution; no new test duplicates that checker guard.

mutants.name: R2-stale-frontier
mutants.rule: A line starts with no frontier from the preceding line; WorkspaceAgreesWithReferences reuses storage across generated texts.

mutants.name: R2-stale-marks
mutants.rule: Reset advances the closure generation, even after an early accept.

mutants.name: R2-frontier-alias
mutants.rule: A transition writes the other frontier, not the active frontier being read.

mutants.name: R2-split-arm
mutants.rule: Epsilon closure reaches both Split arms; the original Simulation and tree model reach both.

mutants.name: R2-early-accept
mutants.rule: Inside may accept before End.

mutants.name: R2-whole
mutants.rule: Whole accepts only at End, not when a prefix accepts.

mutants.name: R2-reallocate
mutants.rule: WorkspaceReusesStorage rejects repeating storage initialization per line even when outputs agree.

mutants.name: R2-yield-stop
mutants.rule: LinesStop rejects pulling another source line after yield returns false.

mutants.name: R2-rollover
mutants.rule: Generation rollover must clear old marks before generation one is reused.

func Measure(c SearchCompiled, text string) Work {
	if c.prefix.Complete {
mutants.to:
func Measure(c SearchCompiled, text string) Work {
	if false {
mutants.rule: Complete literals need no NFA starts or transitions.

mutants.name: R1-alt-prefix
mutants.rule: Only the common prefix of both alternatives is required.

mutants.name: R1-nullable-prefix
mutants.from:
case Any, Class, Star, Quest:
		Prefix{Text: "", Complete: false}
mutants.rule: An optional head may match empty, so its operand is not required.

mutants.name: R1-overlap
mutants.rule: After a candidate, another prefix may start inside it.

mutants.name: R1-whole
mutants.rule: Whole mode must stay anchored, including complete literals.

mutants.name: R1-early-accept
mutants.rule: Inside accepts before End; trailing bytes cannot undo a match.

mutants.name: R1-no-prefix-fallback
mutants.rule: No required prefix is not evidence of no match; nullable patterns still match.

mutants.name: R1-live-candidate
mutants.rule: Starting a later candidate must preserve earlier live configurations.

mutants.name: R1-cat-incomplete
mutants.rule: A concatenation cannot require bytes after an unknown or variable-length head.

mutants.name: R1-plus-complete
mutants.rule: One required literal occurrence does not make a repeat a complete literal.

mutants.name: R1-rescan
mutants.rule: SearchTransitionsAreLinear rejects redundant suffix rescans that Boolean agreement cannot see; the actual sequential-candidate implementation at bb95113d is also red under this law.
